RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from the information provided.

An all-male panel is not, by itself, evidence that sex influenced this decision—particularly as both you and the appointee are men. It may raise a governance question if the bank requires balanced panels, but that is separate from discriminatory selection.

Your doctorate and modelling experience are relevant, but a head role may also prioritize leadership and regulatory expertise; the announcement cannot establish who best met the criteria.

Follow up on your unanswered request. Ask for the selection criteria, how your application was assessed, and the reasons for preferring the successful candidate. Check applicable complaint deadlines rather than waiting indefinitely. Raise panel composition if a relevant rule or further evidence supports doing so.
